subject: Request: Customer quote & usage evidence to support seat-tier upgrade
messages:
From: Heidi Park <heidi@pinelanehealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Helping us make the case for seat-tier upgrade?

Hi Nikhil,

Hope you had a good week. We're on the home stretch for our Q1 budget review and our finance team has asked for a short set of customer references and usage evidence to justify moving from Standard to Pro seats across our analytics team.

Specifically, they want:
- One short customer quote or testimonial we can include in the business case (1-2 sentences).
- A succinct usage snapshot (monthly queries, cost per token trend, any latency improvements since onboarding) — a one-page PDF would be ideal.
- Confirmation we can use PineLane metrics and a quote in Redwood marketing collateral (if agreed).

Can you help? We're targeting the commit by Tue 22 Dec. If you can send a draft testimonial + a usage page that we can attach to the proposal, that would move the needle.

Thanks,
--
Heidi Park
Director, Platform Analytics
PineLane Health
heidi@pinelanehealth.com

P.S. I'll loop in procurement if we need an MSA amendment for seat counts.

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Heidi Park <heidi@pinelanehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Helping us make the case for seat-tier upgrade?

Hi Heidi — great to hear from you and congrats on the momentum. We can absolutely support this. High-level plan:

1) I will send a 1-paragraph draft testimonial + a 1-page usage snapshot (Q3/Q4 monthly queries, avg latency, token volumes) by Monday EOD so you have time to include in the packet.
2) Monica on our CS team will attach the usage export and a short note on observed ROI signals (reduced analyst time on ad-hoc runs).
3) We will clearly mark any figures as PineLane-provided and ask for written approval to use the quote for marketing.

Quick ask: can you confirm the specific audience for the quote (finance vs exec board) and whether the procurement contact should be on the approval thread?

I'll draft the testimonial to be brief and factual so it's easy for you to drop into the deck.

Best,
--
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0162

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Helping us make the case for seat-tier upgrade? -- need usage export + draft testimonial

Monica / Evelyn,

Forwarding PineLane's ask — they need a short testimonial + one-pager usage snapshot for a budget packet by Tue 22 Dec. Please see Heidi's original below.

Can you help with: 
- Monica: export of monthly token/queries for PLH (Aug-Nov + Dec month-to-date), a short bullets list of observed benefits (e.g., reduced queue time, fewer manual runs). Attach as PDF.
- Evelyn: quick review of privacy/compliance language — we need to confirm we have rights to publish a customer quote and that the metric export contains no PHI. If you can provide a short approval line we can include in the request to the customer, that helps.

I'll draft the testimonial and send both to Heidi for approval. Thanks — tight timeline.

Nikhil

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FW: Helping us make the case for seat-tier upgrade? -- usage export attached

Nikhil — attached is a short usage summary (plh_q3_usage_summary.pdf) and a 1-paragraph benefits blurb. Key highlights:
- Monthly queries: Aug avg 9.2k, Sep 11.1k, Oct 12.5k, Nov 13.7k
- Avg token cost per query down ~18% after prefix caching rollout (Sept)
- Median latency for analyst-facing endpoints: 220ms -> 145ms (Oct -> Nov)

I also attached a draft testimonial (draft_testimonial_plh.docx) — I wrote two options: one executive-facing, one concise finance-friendly sentence. Evelyn — we need sign-off if export has any fields that could be considered PHI (should be all aggregated).

Attachments: plh_q3_usage_summary.pdf, draft_testimonial_plh.docx

Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Heidi Park <heidi@pinelanehealth.com>, Sourcing <procurement@pinelanehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Draft testimonial + usage snapshot for PineLane budget packet (requesting approval)

Hi Heidi — attaching two items for your review and sign-off:
1) plh_q3_usage_summary.pdf (one-page usage snapshot) — Monica compiled this.
2) draft_testimonial_plh.docx — two short options; please pick one or edit.

Short ask in this email: can you reply with which testimonial option you prefer and a single-sentence approval to include the quote and the usage snapshot in our (and your) decks? For example: "PineLane Health approves use of the attached usage snapshot and the following testimonial: ‘Redwoodallowed our analytics team to reduce ad-hoc run times and scale queries while keeping costs predictable.’"

We also included a one-pager about Redwood features tied to observed benefits (redwood_onepager_v3.pdf) — that's optional for your packet. If procurement needs an MSA amendment for increased seat counts, copy procurement on the reply and we'll loop legal.

Thanks for the quick turn — happy to hop on a 15-min call if you'd rather run through the figures.

Best,
Nikhil
--
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil_sharma@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0162

Nikhil / Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround, both attachments look good. Procurement is looped for the seat counts.

We prefer the finance-friendly sentence (Option B). Use this sentence exactly as the quote in the deck: "Redwood allowed our analytics team to reduce ad-hoc run times and scale queries while keeping costs predictable."

You have permission to: 
- Include the attached one-page usage snapshot in internal PineLane materials and in Redwood marketing collateral.
- Use the quote above verbatim in Redwood case materials.

Procurement: we will open an amendment request for the additional seats this week; procurement@pinelanehealth.com is the contact for MSA work.

Heidi
Director, Platform Analytics
PineLane Health
